ddl: CREATE NODE TABLE Resource(key STRING, source STRING, scopeKey STRING, version STRING, id STRING, kind STRING, lexicon STRING, listedType STRING, location STRING, nativeId STRING, name STRING, address STRING, ownership STRING, engineOwnership STRING, attrs STRING, tags STRING, facts STRING, observedAt STRING, PRIMARY KEY(key))
CREATE NODE TABLE CloudId(value STRING, kind STRING, PRIMARY KEY(value))
CREATE REL TABLE KNOWN_AS(FROM Resource TO CloudId)
CREATE REL TABLE REF(FROM Resource TO Resource, kind STRING, viaAttr STRING, toAttr STRING, grain STRING, origin STRING, rule STRING, relation STRING, ambiguous BOOLEAN)

inserts.Resource: CREATE (:Resource {key: $key, source: $source, scopeKey: $scopeKey, version: $version, id: $id, kind: $kind, lexicon: $lexicon, listedType: $listedType, location: $location, nativeId: $nativeId, name: $name, address: $address, ownership: $ownership, engineOwnership: $engineOwnership, attrs: $attrs, tags: $tags, facts: $facts, observedAt: $observedAt})
inserts.REF: MATCH (a:Resource {key: $from}), (b:Resource {key: $to}) CREATE (a)-[:REF {kind: $kind, viaAttr: $viaAttr, toAttr: $toAttr, grain: $grain, origin: $origin, rule: $rule, relation: $relation, ambiguous: $ambiguous}]->(b)

templates.name: dependents-all
templates.title: What depends on it, across every source
templates.query: MATCH (o:Resource)-[:REF*1..6]->(r:Resource {key: $key}) RETURN DISTINCT o.key AS key, o.kind AS kind, o.scopeKey AS scope

templates.name: dependencies-all
templates.title: What it depends on, across every source
templates.query: MATCH (r:Resource {key: $key})-[:REF*1..6]->(o:Resource) RETURN DISTINCT o.key AS key, o.kind AS kind, o.scopeKey AS scope

templates.name: ownership
templates.title: Ownership
templates.query: MATCH (r:Resource {key: $key}) OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:KNOWN_AS]->(:CloudId)<-[:KNOWN_AS]-(o:Resource) WHERE o.key <> r.key RETURN r.key AS key, r.ownership AS ownership, r.engineOwnership AS engineOwnership, r.facts AS facts, r.observedAt AS observedAt, collect(DISTINCT o.key) AS sameObject
templates.note: ownership is chant's marker verdict, owned or foreign. engineOwnership is an engine's, bound, unowned, pending or foreign. Absent is unknown, never guessed. A cloud listing reads markers only.

templates.name: same-object
templates.title: The same object in other sources
templates.query: MATCH (r:Resource {key: $key})-[:KNOWN_AS]->(c:CloudId)<-[:KNOWN_AS]-(o:Resource) WHERE o.scopeKey <> r.scopeKey RETURN DISTINCT o.key AS key, o.scopeKey AS scope, c.value AS cloudId, c.kind AS cloudIdKind

templates.name: readers
templates.title: Who reads it from another estate or root
templates.query: MATCH (o:Resource)-[e:REF]->(r:Resource {key: $key}) WHERE o.scopeKey <> r.scopeKey RETURN o.key AS key, o.scopeKey AS scope, e.viaAttr AS via, e.origin AS origin, e.rule AS rule UNION MATCH (r:Resource {key: $key})-[:KNOWN_AS]->(:CloudId)<-[:KNOWN_AS]-(t:Resource)<-[e:REF]-(o:Resource) WHERE o.scopeKey <> r.scopeKey RETURN o.key AS key, o.scopeKey AS scope, e.viaAttr AS via, e.origin AS origin, e.rule AS rule
templates.note: A derived edge (origin derived, rule identity:<kind>) is an identity match, not a declared reference.

templates.name: history
templates.title: History
templates.query: MATCH (r:Resource {key: $key}) RETURN r.key AS key, r.facts AS facts, r.version AS version, r.observedAt AS observedAt
templates.note: The record's versions come from facts.recordVersions, when the engine ran with -history or --versions. Snapshot history (chant#4519's store) is not loaded into the session yet.
